summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend tests for the extended admin dashboard: account settings (email/password with token invalidation), theme customizer (public/admin endpoints), dashboard stats, activity logs, backup/restore, view counter. All 13 backend tests passed. Playwright frontend flow passed: login, all 13 admin tabs present, Overview stats visible, Appearance preset/mode/radius/save works, Backup JSON downloads, Activity tab renders, Settings form validation works, portfolio home page renders all sections with no console errors. Admin credentials restored to Admin@123 after tests.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 760 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, admin, public, backup) as it grows.
seed_admin() does not raise/log errors on hash failure - acceptable, but adding structured logging on password change would help audit trails (already logs activity).
restore_backup replaces all collections without a server-side backup snapshot; consider automatic pre-restore snapshot for safety.
Public GET /api/profile increments view counter on every hit including admin previews, which may inflate views. Consider excluding admin origins or gating with a cookie/header.
log_activity has no size cap - activity_logs collection can grow unbounded; consider TTL index or periodic pruning.
seed_data_creation: None - tests use TEST_ prefixed transient data and clean up. Restore test re-inserts existing backup data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth (login, wrong creds, token invalidation on password/email change), theme, stats, activity logs, backup/restore. Frontend Playwright verifies admin dashboard tabs, appearance customizer (preset-blue changes primary to #2563EB, mode-dark/light toggles html data-theme, radius slider, backup download filename portfolio-backup-<date>.json). Admin creds are always restored to Admin@123 at end of tests.
